notes.title: V1. 03 version update
notes.content:
1. Adjust the plot of the main line, add voice playback, and add the main line: Apocalypse plan.

2. The level is adjusted to a single scene, and there is a probability of dropping powerful props without the upper limit of superposition.

3. Add 2 sets of broken series suits: Witchcraft suit and storm Knight suit, which are used for plot transition.

4. Add 18 magic color series powerful weapons, which can be obtained above purgatory difficulty.

notes.title: V1. 02 version update
notes.content:
In the exploration level, the functions of automatic walking and automatic shooting are added.

Other scenes, such as corpse tide, attack and defense, and Legion hegemony, cannot fight automatically.

Other updates:

1. Adjust the size of some checkpoints and increase the combat area.

2. The new mount system can challenge and tame different beasts to become your own mount.

3. The new mount combat system can control the mount release skill while shooting.

4. Adjust the acquisition of daily activity and speed up the completion of daily tasks.

5. Quantum summon can summon the biochemical wolf mount.

6. Corpse tide added and dropped: exchange materials for witchcraft suit · light and storm Knight · light suit.

7. Fix known bugs.

notes.title: V1. 01 version update
notes.content:
1、 Four Roulike props are added to the exploration level, which can be released after being obtained.

Props include: (affected by the character's attack)

1. Chicken God: place the rooster and pester the monster that startles it.

2. Oil gun: spray oil on the monster and ignite it.

3. Flying backpack: Ignite the backpack and let yourself spray into the sky.

4. High pressure bomb: throw a high-pressure bomb at the monster. After the explosion, high pressure is generated, so that the monster cannot land.

2、 Optimize the main city scene and display the image of active players.

3、 New double copy: Double dream. It is similar to the way of playing in a double line. Team up with your friends to explore and solve puzzles.
